Features.section_title: Comprehensive Digital Solutions for Modern Businesses
Features.section_description: We combine technical expertise with creative design to deliver a complete package for your online business needs.
Features.feature1_description: We build tailor-made web and mobile applications designed around your specific workflows — no templates, no cookie-cutter solutions. Your app, your rules.
Features.feature2_description: From logos and brand kits to social graphics and marketing materials, we create visuals that make your business instantly recognizable and professionally presented.
Features.feature3_description: We handle your content calendar, post creation, scheduling, and platform strategy across multiple channels so you stay consistent online without the daily grind.
Features.feature4_description: Our AI agent posts, engages, and grows your X/Twitter presence daily — keeping your account active and visible even when you're focused on running your business.
Features.feature5_description: We produce written and visual content optimized for your audience — from blog posts and captions to short-form video scripts that drive real engagement.
Features.feature6_description: Data-driven campaigns across paid and organic channels, built around your goals — whether that's leads, brand awareness, or direct sales.

items.question: What makes your social media management and Twitter automation services unique?
items.answer: We combine human strategy with AI-assisted scheduling to post consistently across platforms, tailored to your brand voice, without you lifting a finger.

items.question: Will the posts include graphics?
items.answer: Yes. All social media posts include custom-designed graphics matched to your brand identity.

items.question: Can I request custom post designs?
items.answer: Yes, all plans include custom-designed posts. Enterprise clients receive priority design requests and 3 custom videos per month.

items.question: How often will my social media be updated?
items.answer: Depending on your plan: Essentials gets 2 posts per week, Growth gets 2 posts per week across 3 platforms, Enterprise gets 4 posts per week across 4 platforms.

items.question: Will Twitter post multiple times per day with the AI agent?
items.answer: The AI Twitter agent on Growth and Enterprise plans is configured to post at optimal times for engagement, typically 1-3 times per day depending on your niche activity.

items.question: Do you respond to comments and messages?
items.answer: Our Enterprise plan includes community management. Essentials and Growth plans focus on content publishing.

items.question: How does the Twitter automation service work?
items.answer: We deploy an AI agent that posts relevant content to your X/Twitter account daily, engages with trending topics in your niche, and grows your following on autopilot.

items.question: Can I cancel or upgrade my plan anytime?
items.answer: Yes. All plans are month-to-month with no long-term contracts. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel at any time.
